text: The Nominating Panel – Administrative Penalty Tribunal will select candidates for interview for appointment to the Administrative Penalty Tribunal. Following interviews, the Nominating Panel will recommend 19 candidates to City Council for appointment to the Administrative Penalty Tribunal, including one as Chair.
